🎵 About Ukulele vs Guitar (Short Understanding)

The ukulele is a small, four-stringed instrument originally from Hawaii, traditionally strung with nylon strings and tuned G-C-E-A.

The guitar is a larger six-stringed instrument available in acoustic, classical, and electric variants, with a wider range of tones.

The ukulele offers a lighter, cheerful tone and is generally easier for young beginners, while the guitar provides a broader tonal range and greater repertoire depth.
